title: 韩冬郎即席为诗相送一座尽惊他日余方追吟连宵侍坐裴回久之句有老成之风因成二绝寄酬兼呈畏之员外 一
author: 李商隐
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-bleed 9:16 portrait illustration for a premium Chinese poetry reader. Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. The central and lower 65% must be almost blank warm ivory writing paper for separately rendered poem text. No strong shapes below that area; tiny pale motifs at outermost bottom corners only if truly needed. All four paper edges are full bleed: no frame, rectangular picture boundary, green outer border, UI, collage, modern objects, written characters, title, calligraphy, stamp, seal, logo or watermark. Not a generic interchangeable landscape: use the exact poem's setting, season, emotional tone and main visual moment. Paint no words from the poem.
Specific scene: A talented child composing at a low desk beside an older man, the last candle and cooling brazier at a farewell evening; a subtle wutong blossom branch above. Intimate admiration, avoid literal giant phoenixes or visible writing.
Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 韩冬郎即席为诗相送一座尽惊他日余方追吟连宵侍坐裴回久之句有老成之风因成二绝寄酬兼呈畏之员外 一 — 李商隐
十岁裁诗走马成，冷灰残烛动离情。
桐花万里丹山路，雏凤清于老凤声。
EDIT: Edit the reference illustration, preserving its exact portrait canvas, warm ivory paper, father-and-young-son composition, delicate Chinese watercolor style and huge lower blank text area. Correct ONLY two details: the brazier at far left contains cold dull grey ashes, with NO visible flames, NO orange glow and NO smoke (the poem says 冷灰). Remove the large decorative white blossoms overhead; replace them with a restrained leafy wutong branch high at the edge, no flowers. Keep the small nearly spent candle, boy writing and attentive older man unchanged. No words, seals, UI or borders.
visualReview: 第二版逐张查看：保留十岁少年执笔与长者欣赏的关系，把初版燃炉改为冷灰并移去不当白花；残烛、夜色、下方大留白保持，人物手部未见明显错误。
